tools.name: device_scope_capture
tools.description: Arm a Keysight InfiniiVision-class scope, capture a single window on one channel via SCPI :WAVEFORM:DATA?, return raw (time_us, voltage) samples as CSV-encoded text inside the JSON response.

channel.description: Scope channel (1..4) connected to the signal under test.

trigger_level_v.description: Trigger threshold in volts (1.5V = mid-rail for 3.3V CMOS).

trigger_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the first trigger before giving up.

no_configure.description: Skip channel/timebase setup (use scope's current state).

tools.name: device_scope_periodic_pulse_check
tools.description: Capture a single window from a Keysight scope, find LOW pulses by hysteresis threshold-cross, and return PASS/FAIL based on whether ≥2 pulses match a target inter-pulse period (within tolerance). Designed for catching periodic anomalies like the v0.64 wake_ctrl tITO timer-freeze bug.

channel.description: Scope channel (1..4) connected to the signal under test.

trigger_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the first trigger before giving up.

period_ms.description: Expected inter-pulse period (milliseconds). Pulses with consecutive gaps near this value are considered periodic.

period_tol_ms.description: Tolerance (± ms) for the periodicity match.

low_thresh_v.description: Voltage below which the signal is considered LOW (hysteresis low rail).

high_thresh_v.description: Voltage above which the signal is considered HIGH (hysteresis high rail).

no_configure.description: Skip channel/timebase setup (use scope's current state).

resources.name: current_setup
resources.description: Live read of trigger / timebase / channel / probe state via SCPI query (no acquisition arm). Returns the current scope configuration so agents can reason about it before invoking capture tools.
